settings.title: Why should we shop with you?
settings.content:
Better Prices – Our prices are often cheaper than retail stores.

Easy Access – We offer in-person pickup and local delivery for your convenience.

See Before You Buy – No more worrying about wrong sizes, fit, or colors. Visit us in-store to check out your item before purchasing!

settings.title: Why didn’t my shoes come in their original box?
settings.content: Some of our products come from the same warehouses as retailers like TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Ross, and Nike Factory Stores. For storage and display purposes, these stores sometimes remove or cut off the lids of shoeboxes to make them easier to transport and sell.

settings.title: Are your items authentic?
settings.content: Yes! All of our products are 100% authenticand sourced from verified retailers, distributors, and wholesalers.

settings.title: Why are prices cheaper online than in-store?
settings.content:
VISNKRCO operates under a sublease within the Refresh Atlanta storefront, which comes with significantly higher overhead costs—more than 10X that of running our online store. To offset these expenses, some in-store prices may be higher.

However, we are happy to price match with our online store. If you find an item in-store that’s listed for a lower price online, just let us know, and we’ll adjust it accordingly.

settings.title: Are these items used?
settings.content: No, all items are brand new unless stated otherwise. However, because some products come from liquidation and closeout sales, they may have minor discoloration or marks from long-term storage. Please check the product description for specific details.

settings.title: Do you ship to the U.S. Virgin Islands?
settings.content: Absolutely! Serving the U.S. Virgin Islands is one of our top priorities. We ship to all three islands—St. Thomas, St. John, and St. Croix.
